```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error=TRUE)
library(R2sample)
st=function() knitr::knit_exit()
B=1000
```

## Tests and Power - Continuous Data Without Weights

```{r}
myTSc1 = function(x, y) {
  out=abs(mean(x)-mean(y))
  names(out)="Mean"
  out
}
myTSc2 = function(x, y, TSextra) {
  xtmp=diff(TSextra$quant(x))
  ytmp=diff(TSextra$quant(y))
  out=c(abs(median(x)-median(y)),abs(xtmp-ytmp))
  names(out)=c("Median", "IQR")
  out
}
TSextra=list(quant=function(x) quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75)))
hybrid=function(mu) {
   x=rnorm(100,mu)
   list(x=x, y=rnorm(120,mean(x),sd(x)))
}
rnull=function(dta) {
   list(x=dta$x,y=rnorm(120,mean(dta$x),sd(dta$x)))
}
```

```{r}
dta=hybrid(0)
x = dta$x
y = dta$y
twosample_test(dta, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, B=B, doMethod = c("KS", "AD"))
twosample_test(x, y, rnull=rnull, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, TS=myTSc1, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, TS=myTSc2, TSextra=TSextra, B=B)
```



```{r adj}
twosample_test_adjusted_pvalue(dta, B=B)
```

```{r}
f = function(m) list(x=rnorm(100), y=rnorm(120, m))
twosample_power(f, c(0, 0.5), B=B)
twosample_power(f, c(0, 0.5), TS=myTSc1, B=B)
twosample_power(f, c(0, 0.5), TS=myTSc2, TSextra=TSextra,B=B)
twosample_power(hybrid, c(0, 0.5), rnull=rnull, B=B)
twosample_power(hybrid, c(0, 0.5), rnull=rnull, 
                TS=myTSc2, TSextra=TSextra, B=B)
```


## Tests and Power - Discrete Data without Weights

```{r}
myTSd1 = function(x, y, vals) {
  out=abs(mean(x*vals)-mean(y*vals))
  names(out)="D"
  out
}
myTSd2 = function(x, y, vals, TSextra) {
  xtmp=TSextra$quant(rep(vals,x))
  ytmp=TSextra$quant(rep(vals,y))
  out=c(abs(median(x*vals)-median(y*vals)),abs(xtmp-ytmp))
  names(out)=c("Median", "IQR")
  out
}
TSextra=list(quant=function(x) diff(quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))))
hybrid=function(p) {
   x=table(c(0:5,rbinom(500, 5, p)))-1
   phat=mean(rep(0:5,x))/5
   list(x=x, 
        y=table(c(0:5,rbinom(600, 5, phat)))-1, 
        vals=0:5)
}
f = function(p) {
  vals=0:5
  x = table(c(0:5, rbinom(500, 5, 0.5)))-1
  y = table(c(0:5, rbinom(600, 5, p)))-1
  list(x=x, y=y, vals=vals)  
}
dta=f(0.5)
x=dta$x;y=dta$y;vals=0:5
rnull=function(dta) {
   phat=mean(rep(0:5,dta$x))/5
   list(x=dta$x, 
        y=table(c(0:5,rbinom(600, 5, phat)))-1, 
        vals=0:5)
}
```

```{r}
twosample_test(dta, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, vals, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, vals, rnull=rnull, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, vals, B=B, doMethod = c("KS", "AD"))
twosample_test(x, y, vals, TS=myTSd1, B=B)
twosample_test(x, y, vals, TS=myTSd2, TSextra=TSextra, B=B)
```

```{r}
twosample_test_adjusted_pvalue(dta, B=B)
```

```{r}
twosample_power(f, c(0.5, 0.6), B=B)
twosample_power(hybrid, c(0.5, 0.6), rnull=rnull, B=B)
twosample_power(f, c(0.5, 0.6), TS=myTSd1, B=B)
twosample_power(f, c(0.5, 0.6), TS=myTSd2, TSextra=TSextra,B=B)
```

## Tests and Power - Continuous Data With Weights

```{r}
t=seq(-5,5,length=250)
w=function(x) dnorm(x)/dt(x, 3)
plot(t, w(t),type="l")
```


```{r}
x=rnorm(100)
wx=rep(1, length(x))
y=rt(120, 3)
wy=w(y)
twosample_test(x, y, wx=wx, wy=wy, B=B)
f=function(m) {
  x=rnorm(100, m)
  wx=rep(1, length(x))
  y=rt(200, 3)
  y=y[abs(y)<5][1:120]
  wy=dnorm(y)/dt(y, 3)
  list(x=x, y=y, wx=wx, wy=wy)
}
twosample_power(f, m=c(0, 0.5, 1), B=B)
```

## run.studies

The new tests are simple chisquare tests, either with or without p value:

```{r}
TSextra=list(nbins=5, statistic=FALSE)
run.studies(1:2, 1:2, TS=myTS_cont, TSextra=TSextra, 
    data_type="cont",With.p.value=TRUE, 
    SuppressMessages = TRUE, B=100)
TSextra=list(nbins=5, statistic=TRUE)
run.studies(1:2, 1:2, TS=myTS_disc, TSextra=TSextra, 
    data_type="disc", SuppressMessages = TRUE, B=100)

```
